question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Her room looks very __messy__
solution:
The correct answer is "**Organised.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words;
 
 
• **The given word 'messy' ****means untidy or disorganized.(**गन्दा या अव्यवस्थित।**)**

 
 
• Example: Her apartment was very messy.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym of 'messy' would be a word that means tidy or organized.
 
 
• **"Organized" (व्यवस्थित)** **means something arranged in a systematic manner**.
 
 
• Example: She oranizes her table very nicely.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, option 4 Organised is the most appropriate antonym as it means everything is in order and well arranged.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Untidy)** (अव्यवस्थित) is a synonym of messy, which means not neat or well arranged.
 
• Option 2 (Chaotic) (अराजक)** **means in a state of complete confusion and disorder.
 
• Option 3 (Disordered) (व्यवस्था बिगड़ी हुई) means lacking order or regular arrangement.
